description: This source file is an HTML document that implements the front-end interface for a database viewer application. It contains structure, styling, and client-side scripting for displaying databases, tables, and data fetched via API calls.

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches the list of databases and renders them on the sidebar.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Refreshes the list of databases and resets the view.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Expands or collapses the list of tables for a selected database.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Fetches and displays tables for the selected database.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Loads and displays data for the selected table.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Renders the data into an HTML table, handling wide content and object display.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Creates HTML for individual cell content, supporting expandable objects and long strings.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Expands or collapses cell content for better viewing of long texts or objects.
